name: blockchain-ipfs-hybrid-system
description: Monorepo scripts for app, backend, and contracts

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n CHAIN,DEPLOY,API,UI -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "powershell -NoProfile -Command cd contracts; npx hardhat node" "powershell -NoProfile -Command Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; cd contracts; npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network localhost" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix contracts run test && npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix app run test
